ambiguities_or_notes: оставление ее в совершенно том виде, в котором она есть is rendered 'that it be left exactly as it is,' preserving Tolstoy's third repeated demand for textual noninterference.
The alternative-title sentence is construed as leaving the choice between the notebook's existing title and 'A Suicide. A Marker's Story' entirely to Nekrasov; no preferred title is inferred.
(Н. С.) is translated as (N. L.) because the source explicitly explains it as новая строка, 'new line'.
The editorial note's 1883 is retained as an explicitly identified autograph error rather than silently corrected.
